mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the sensory and motor roots was most worthwhile: the picture showed how one nerve can contain separate fibres carrying messages in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the brain in the skull was clear but predictable; the picture already showed where it belonged.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the spinal cord can help produce quick responses without waiting for a conscious decision.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless. The last two combinations followed explicit goals and were the only available choices, though that left little to decide.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how these nerve routes connect to muscles and other body parts. The separate message directions made the model interesting, although the last choices were straightforward.
